a1-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hello and Thanks
a1-01.scenario: Károly says hi to you at a café and offers you a tea.
a1-01.prompt: Say hi back, then accept the tea and thank him.
a1-01.canDo: I can greet someone and respond simply in Hungarian.

a1-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Who
a1-02.scenario: You meet Károly for the first time. Meg is with you.
a1-02.prompt: Say hi, say who you are (you are Anna), and tell him who she is.
a1-02.target: Szia! Én Anna vagyok. Ő Meg.
a1-02.canDo: I can say who I am.

a1-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is This?
a1-03.scenario: Károly puts something on the table that you don't recognize. Next to it is your book.
a1-03.prompt: Ask what it is. Then point to your book and say what it is.
a1-03.english: What is this? This is a book.
a1-03.canDo: I can ask what something is.

a1-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Me
a1-04.scenario: At the station a man asks you: Te Meg vagy? You are Anna.
a1-04.prompt: Say no, you're not Meg, say who you are, and ask if he is Károly.
a1-04.target: Nem, nem vagyok Meg. Anna vagyok. Te Károly vagy?
a1-04.english: No, I'm not Meg. I'm Anna. Are you Károly?
a1-04.canDo: I can ask and answer a yes/no question.

a1-05.title: Communicative Challenge: At Meg's
a1-05.scenario: You visit Meg. Károly is there too and hands you a cup.
a1-05.prompt: Greet Károly, ask what it is, and when he says it's a coffee, thank him.
a1-05.english: Hi, Károly! What is this? Thank you!
a1-05.canDo: I can use the core Unit 1 patterns in a short exchange.

a1-06.title: Communicative Challenge: Good Morning and Goodbye
a1-06.scenario: You meet Károly at the café in the morning. Later, when you leave, you say goodbye.
a1-06.prompt: Greet Károly with good morning, then say goodbye as you leave.
a1-06.canDo: I can greet someone and say goodbye at any time of day.

a1-07.title: Communicative Challenge: Please and Thank You
a1-07.scenario: Anna hands you a tea, but accidentally bumps your arm and apologizes.
a1-07.prompt: Thank Anna for the tea, and tell her that it's no problem.
cues: Say that it is no problem
a1-07.canDo: I can say please, thank you, and sorry in Hungarian.

a1-08.title: Communicative Challenge: How Are You?
a1-08.scenario: You run into Károly outside. He asks how you are doing.
a1-08.prompt: Tell Károly you are doing well, thank him, and ask how he is.
a1-08.canDo: I can ask someone how they are and say how I am.

a1-09.title: Communicative Challenge: Could You Repeat That?
a1-09.scenario: Mariann speaks very quickly and you do not catch what she said.
a1-09.prompt: Say you don't understand, and ask her to speak more slowly.
cues: Ask her to speak more slowly
a1-09.english: I don't understand. More slowly, please.
a1-09.canDo: I can ask someone to repeat or slow down when I do not understand.

a1-10.title: Communicative Challenge: Small Agreements
a1-10.scenario: András asks if you can wait five minutes before leaving.
a1-10.prompt: Agree to wait by saying okay.
a1-10.canDo: I can agree to requests using rendben and persze.

a1-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Morning Encounter
a1-10-consolidation.scenario: You meet Anna in the morning. She asks how you are. Before leaving, you say goodbye.
a1-10-consolidation.prompt: Greet Anna with good morning, say you are well, thank her, and say goodbye.
cues: Say you are well and thank her
a1-10-consolidation.target: Jó reggelt! Jól vagyok, köszönöm. Viszlát!
a1-10-consolidation.english: Good morning! I'm well, thanks. Goodbye!
a1-10-consolidation.canDo: I can greet people and say goodbye in Hungarian.

a1-11.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Are You?
a1-11.scenario: You meet Anna at a gathering. She introduces herself and asks who you are.
a1-11.prompt: Tell Anna who you are (you are Meg) and ask who she is.
a1-11.target: Én Meg vagyok. Te ki vagy?
a1-11.english: I am Meg. Who are you?
a1-11.canDo: I can use én, te, and ő with vagyok and vagy to say who I am.

a1-12.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is That?
a1-12.scenario: Károly points to someone across the room.
a1-12.prompt: Ask Károly who she is, and when he says it's Anna, say she is a friend.
a1-12.english: Who is she? She is a friend.
a1-12.canDo: I can ask Ki ő? and Mi ez? to ask who or what something is.

a1-13.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Do You Live?
a1-13.scenario: You are chatting with Anna. She asks where you live in the city.
a1-13.prompt: Tell Anna you live here, and ask where she lives.
a1-13.target: Én itt lakom. És te, hol laksz?
a1-13.english: I live here. And you, where do you live?
a1-13.canDo: I can ask Hol laksz? and understand what it means.

a1-14.title: Communicative Challenge: Friends and People
a1-14.scenario: Anna asks you about the person standing next to Károly.
a1-14.prompt: Tell Anna he is a man and he is a friend.
a1-14.target: Ő egy férfi. Ő egy barát.
a1-14.english: He is a man. He is a friend.
a1-14.canDo: I can identify someone as a man, woman, or friend using simple noun phrases.

a1-15.title: Communicative Challenge: Introducing Myself
a1-15.scenario: You meet András for the first time with Károly.
a1-15.prompt: Say who you are (Meg), say you live here, and introduce Károly as a friend.
a1-15.target: Én Meg vagyok. Itt lakom. Károly egy barát.
a1-15.english: I am Meg. I live here. Károly is a friend.
a1-15.canDo: I can introduce myself and say who another person is.

a1-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: New in Budapest
a1-15-consolidation.scenario: You arrive at a meetup in Budapest and introduce yourself to the group.
a1-15-consolidation.prompt: Introduce yourself as Meg, say who your friend is (Károly), and say you live here.
a1-15-consolidation.target: Én Meg vagyok. Ő Károly. Itt lakom.
a1-15-consolidation.english: I am Meg. He is Károly. I live here.
a1-15-consolidation.canDo: I can introduce myself and identify another person.

a1-16a.title: Communicative Challenge: Counting to Ten
a1-16a.scenario: Károly is counting items on the table and stops at two.
a1-16a.prompt: Continue counting for him with three, four, and five.
a1-16a.canDo: I can count from zero to ten in Hungarian.

a1-16b.title: Communicative Challenge: Counting Teens
a1-16b.scenario: Károly counts eleven and twelve, then asks you to continue.
a1-16b.prompt: Say the next two numbers: thirteen and fourteen.
a1-16b.canDo: I can count from eleven to nineteen in Hungarian.

a1-17.title: Communicative Challenge: How Old Are You?
a1-17.scenario: Károly asks you how old you are. You are thirty years old.
a1-17.prompt: Tell Károly you are thirty years old, then ask how old he is.
a1-17.target: Harminc éves vagyok. És te, hány éves vagy?
a1-17.english: I am thirty years old. And you, how old are you?
a1-17.canDo: I can ask someone how old they are using Hány éves vagy?

a1-18.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Do You Live?
a1-18.scenario: Anna asks where you live and what your address is.
a1-18.prompt: Tell Anna you live in Budapest, and give your address as Kossuth Street 10.
a1-18.target: Budapesten lakom. A címem Kossuth utca 10.
a1-18.english: I live in Budapest. My address is Kossuth Street 10.
a1-18.canDo: I can ask someone where they live and say where I live.

a1-19.title: Communicative Challenge: Phone Number
a1-19.scenario: Károly asks for your phone number so he can call you later.
cues: Say it is your phone number
a1-19.target: A telefonszámom nulla hat, harminc, egy kettő három, négy öt hat hét.
a1-19.canDo: I can ask for and give a Hungarian phone number.

a1-20.title: Communicative Challenge: Exchanging Details
a1-20.scenario: You meet Anna at the community center and she asks about you.
a1-20.prompt: Tell Anna you are thirty years old and that you live in Budapest.
a1-20.english: I am thirty years old. I live in Budapest.
a1-20.canDo: I can exchange basic personal details including age, address, and phone number.

a1-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Meeting New Friends
a1-20-consolidation.scenario: At a meetup, Károly asks your name, where you live, and how old you are.
a1-20-consolidation.prompt: Say you are Meg, you live here, and you are thirty years old.
a1-20-consolidation.target: Én Meg vagyok. Itt lakom. Harminc éves vagyok.
a1-20-consolidation.english: I am Meg. I live here. I am thirty years old.
a1-20-consolidation.canDo: I can ask and answer about age.

a1-21.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is This?
a1-21.scenario: You ask Károly what is on the table, then say what you think it is.
a1-21.prompt: Ask what it is, then say it is a coffee.
a1-21.english: What is this? This is a coffee.
a1-21.canDo: I can point at something and ask what it is with Mi ez?

a1-22.title: Communicative Challenge: Tables and Chairs
a1-22.scenario: Károly is showing you around his place. You point out the furniture you see.
a1-22.prompt: Say that this is a table, and that is a chair.
a1-22.target: Ez egy asztal. Az egy szék.
a1-22.english: This is a table. That is a chair.
a1-22.canDo: I can name everyday objects and say there's one of something with egy.

a1-23.title: Communicative Challenge: In the Kitchen
a1-23.scenario: Meg is looking for the phone in the apartment and asks you where it is.
a1-23.prompt: Tell Meg that the phone is in the kitchen.
cues: Name the phone with the article
Say it is in the kitchen
a1-23.english: The phone is in the kitchen.
a1-23.canDo: I can say what's in a room using the suffix -ban/-ben.

a1-24.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is Here
a1-24.scenario: You and Károly are checking what is in the room. He asks about a chair and a lamp.
a1-24.prompt: Say that there is a chair here, but there is no lamp here.
cues: Say there is a chair here
Say there is no lamp here
a1-24.target: Itt van egy szék. Itt nincs lámpa.
a1-24.english: There is a chair here. There is no lamp here.
a1-24.canDo: I can say whether something exists or not with van and nincs.

a1-25.title: Communicative Challenge: Finding the Key
a1-25.scenario: Meg is in the flat and asks about the key. You see it in the room.
a1-25.prompt: Tell Meg that this is a key, and it is in the room.
cues: Say it is in the room
a1-25.target: Ez egy kulcs. A szobában van.
a1-25.english: This is a key. It is in the room.
a1-25.canDo: I can talk about objects in the apartment and where they are.

a1-25-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Around the Flat
a1-25-consolidation.scenario: You visit Károly's apartment and notice something on the table. You ask what it is, and where the key is.
a1-25-consolidation.prompt: Ask what that is, and ask where the key is.
a1-25-consolidation.target: Mi az? Hol van a kulcs?
a1-25-consolidation.english: What is that? Where is the key?
a1-25-consolidation.canDo: I can name objects and say where they are using itt, ott, and -ban/-ben.

a1-26.title: Communicative Challenge: My Family
a1-26.scenario: Meg is looking at a photo on Károly's desk and asks who is in it.
a1-26.prompt: Tell Meg that this is your family, and point out your mother.
a1-26.target: Ez a családom. Ő az anyám.
a1-26.english: This is my family. She is my mother.
a1-26.canDo: I can name close family members: anya, apa, szülő.

a1-27.title: Communicative Challenge: Siblings and Children
a1-27.scenario: Károly asks if you have a sibling or a son.
a1-27.prompt: Tell Károly that you have a sibling, but you don't have a son.
cues: Say you do not have a son
a1-27.english: I have a sibling. I don't have a son.
a1-27.canDo: I can name more family members: testvér, fiú, lány, gyerek.

a1-28.title: Communicative Challenge: Older and Younger
a1-28.scenario: Meg sees a young man in the hallway and asks if he is your younger brother.
a1-28.prompt: Tell Meg that he is not your younger brother, he is your older brother.
cues: Say he is not your younger brother
Say he is your older brother
a1-28.target: Ő nem az öcsém. Ő a bátyám.
a1-28.english: He is not my younger brother. He is my older brother.
a1-28.canDo: I can distinguish older and younger siblings: báty, öcs, nővér, húg.

a1-29.title: Communicative Challenge: Grandparents
a1-29.scenario: You and Meg are looking at family pictures. You point out your grandparents.
a1-29.prompt: Point to the photo and introduce your grandmother and your grandfather.
a1-29.target: Ő a nagymamám. Ő a nagypapám.
a1-29.english: She is my grandmother. He is my grandfather.
a1-29.canDo: I can introduce my grandparents: nagymama, nagypapa.

a1-30.title: Communicative Challenge: Family Gathering
a1-30.scenario: Károly shows you a big family portrait with everyone gathered together.
a1-30.prompt: Comment that there are many family members in the photo, and they are together.
cues: Say there are many family members in the photo
Say the family members are together
a1-30.target: Sok családtag van a képen. A családtagok együtt vannak.
a1-30.english: There are many family members in the photo. The family members are together.
a1-30.canDo: I can say there are many family members in the photo and that they are together.

a1-30-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Family Overview
a1-30-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks you about your family back home and if you have an older sister.
a1-30-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that this is your family, and you have an older sister.
cues: Say that you have an older sister
a1-30-consolidation.target: Ez a családom. Van egy nővérem.
a1-30-consolidation.english: This is my family. I have an older sister.
a1-30-consolidation.canDo: I can introduce my family and say who my siblings are.

a1-31.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is He Like?
a1-31.scenario: Meg sees a new colleague across the room and asks Károly what he is like.
a1-31.prompt: Ask what he is like, then say that he is tall.
a1-31.english: What is he like? He is tall.
a1-31.canDo: I can ask what someone is like with Milyen?

a1-32.title: Communicative Challenge: Hair and Appearance
a1-32.scenario: Károly describes a friend in a photo to Meg. Meg asks about her hair.
a1-32.prompt: Tell Meg that she is young and has brown hair.
cues: Say that she has brown hair
a1-32.english: She is young. She has brown hair.
a1-32.canDo: I can describe someone's hair using van with a possessive.

a1-33.title: Communicative Challenge: Character
a1-33.scenario: You and Meg meet Károly's brother. Meg asks about his personality.
a1-33.prompt: Tell Meg that he is kind and funny, and that he is not loud.
cues: Say he is kind and funny
a1-33.target: Ő kedves és vicces. Nem hangos.
a1-33.english: He is kind and funny. He is not loud.
a1-33.canDo: I can describe someone's character: kedves, vicces, csendes, hangos.

a1-34.title: Communicative Challenge: Tall Friend
a1-34.scenario: Károly introduces a tall friend standing near the door to Meg.
a1-34.prompt: Tell Meg that he is a tall man, and he is your friend.
cues: Say he is a tall man
a1-34.target: Ő egy magas férfi. Ő a barátom.
a1-34.english: He is a tall man. He is my friend.
a1-34.canDo: I can talk about people in general: ember, férfi, nő, barát.

a1-35.title: Communicative Challenge: Acquaintances
a1-35.scenario: Meg asks about a quiet acquaintance who is helping Károly move a table.
a1-35.prompt: Tell Meg that he is an acquaintance, and he is very strong.
a1-35.english: He is an acquaintance. He is very strong.
a1-35.canDo: I can describe people, combining this unit's adjectives and linking words.

a1-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Describing a Friend
a1-35-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks what your friend is like in general.
a1-35-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that he is tall and kind, and very funny.
cues: Say he is tall and kind
a1-35-consolidation.target: Ő magas és kedves. Nagyon vicces.
a1-35-consolidation.english: He is tall and kind. He is very funny.
a1-35-consolidation.canDo: I can describe people's appearance and character using adjectives and linking words.

a1-51.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking for Károly
a1-51.scenario: You are looking for Károly in the flat and ask Meg where he is. She tells you he is in the kitchen.
a1-51.prompt: Ask Meg where Károly is, and say that he is in the kitchen.
cues: Say he is in the kitchen
a1-51.target: Hol van Károly? A konyhában van.
a1-51.english: Where is Károly? He is in the kitchen.
a1-51.canDo: I can ask and say which room someone or something is in.

a1-52.title: Communicative Challenge: Office or Living Room
a1-52.scenario: Anna calls to ask if you are at the office today. You tell her you are in the living room.
a1-52.prompt: Tell Anna that you are not at the office, and say you are in the living room.
cues: Say you are not at the office
Say you are in the living room
a1-52.target: Nem vagyok az irodában. A nappaliban vagyok.
a1-52.english: I am not at the office. I am in the living room.
a1-52.canDo: I can say whether someone is in the living room, school or office.

a1-53.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Shop
a1-53.scenario: Meg asks where Károly is. You tell her he is at the shop, not in the library.
a1-53.prompt: Tell Meg that Károly is at the shop, and say he is not in the library.
cues: Say Károly is at the shop
Say he is not in the library
a1-53.target: Károly a boltban van. Nem a könyvtárban van.
a1-53.english: Károly is at the shop. He is not in the library.
a1-53.canDo: I can say that someone is at the shop, library or park.

a1-54.title: Communicative Challenge: In the House
a1-54.scenario: Meg asks about your flat and where things are inside the house.
a1-54.prompt: Say that the flat is in the house, and the table is in the room.
cues: Say the flat is in the house
Say the table is in the room
a1-54.target: A lakás a házban van. Az asztal a szobában van.
a1-54.english: The flat is in the house. The table is in the room.
a1-54.canDo: I can locate everyday objects and places in a house or flat.

a1-55.title: Communicative Challenge: Finding the Bag
a1-55.scenario: Meg cannot find her bag before leaving the apartment. She asks where it is, and you see it in the room.
a1-55.prompt: Ask where the bag is, and say that the bag is in the room.
cues: Say the bag is in the room
a1-55.target: Hol van a táska? A táska a szobában van.
a1-55.english: Where is the bag? The bag is in the room.
a1-55.canDo: I can describe where everyday personal items are inside a room.

a1-55-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Things Are
a1-55-consolidation.scenario: At home, Károly is looking for his things. You tell him where the book and the bag are.
a1-55-consolidation.prompt: Say that the book is here in the room, and the bag is in the living room.
cues: Say the book is here in the room
Say the bag is in the living room
a1-55-consolidation.target: A könyv itt van a szobában. A táska a nappaliban van.
a1-55-consolidation.english: The book is here in the room. The bag is in the living room.
a1-55-consolidation.canDo: I can ask where people and objects are and describe their location using -ban/-ben.
